notes: AD season goals: every preseason the athletic director hands you three or four goals scaled to the program (win total, playoff or conference title or Top 25 or postseason, class rank, beat your named rival). A Home card tracks them live; at season's end the review pays budget for each goal met, cools or heats your seat, and moves admin approval. New achievement: Clean sheet. Recruits now come with a high school, classification and senior tape line (position-specific stats), and scouting can reveal a Gem (more upside than his stars say), a Capped prospect, or a Late bloomer.
